embed.title: KunfuApp Template
embed.appContentDescription: Replace this with your app UI. The handshake with Kunfupay is complete.
embed.step1: Add your Prisma models in prisma/schema.prisma
embed.step2: Create your API routes in src/app/api/
embed.step3: Build your embed UI on this page
embed.step4: Run npm run db:push to sync your schema
